summary: Tested AI Lesson Quiz Generator (backend + admin builder UI + student practice quiz) and new Networking/Linux practice content (labs, challenges, quizzes, suggest coverage). Backend 22/22 pytest passed (real AI generation returned 5 valid MCQs in ~15s). Student: lesson-quiz shows PRACTICE ONLY · NO XP, check disabled until 5 answered, 3/5 correct score with green/red feedback + explanations, retry resets, XP unchanged (822 -> 822). Challenges category filter shows Networking (5) and Linux (5). No bugs found.

critical_code_review_comments: Lesson quiz answers are shipped to students in GET /api/paths/{id} (lesson.quiz.questions[].answer). Acceptable since practice-only/no XP, but note it if quizzes ever become graded.
parse_quiz does not reject empty question text/options or duplicate options from the AI; the attach button and the path validator catch empties, so low risk.
/api/builder/lesson-quiz has no rate limit; each click triggers an LLM call (consider a per-user cooldown).
Challenge hint unlock returns 400 for users with <25 XP (admin had <25 XP); this is by design but staff testing hints need XP.
